title: Project Stark | Free
features:
🐾 RIDE A PET — PROJECT STARK

Full auto-farm — eggs, feeding, shop automation and ESP. The farm follows the game's own rules (pickup → auto-deposit at your plot → place → hatch) instead of fighting them.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🥚 AUTO FARM

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

▸ Auto Farm — the full loop: grabs field eggs, rides home (auto-deposits the basket), plants them, hatches when grown

▸ Farm Rarities — only farm the egg tiers you pick (Common → Ethereal)

▸ Farm Delay — adjustable pace between eggs

▸ Volcano Dip — adds the volcano dip stop to the farm loop

▸ Auto Place — plants eggs from your basket into free nests

▸ Place Rarities — choose which eggs get planted

▸ Auto Hatch — hatches every egg once it's fully grown

▸ Egg ESP — highlights field eggs with rarity colours + Refresh button

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🐶 AUTO FEED

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

▸ Auto Feed — keeps pets fed automatically

▸ Feed Foods — pick exactly which foods to use

▸ Feed Pets — pick exactly which pets get fed

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛒 SHOP AUTOMATION

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

▸ Auto Buy Gears — buys your chosen gears when affordable

▸ Auto Buy Food — buys your chosen foods when affordable

▸ Auto Sell — sells your chosen pets at the stall

▸ Auto Upgrade Hatch Luck — auto-buys hatch luck upgrades

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🏃 MOVEMENT & UTILITY

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

▸ Fly — adjustable speed

▸ Noclip

▸ Walkspeed & Jump Height — sliders, re-applied on respawn

▸ Hide Name — hides your nametag and overhead billboard

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✨ EXTRAS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

▸ Live status line + session readout (uptime, player, ping)

▸ Auto-updating — always the latest build from the hub

▸ Per-game configs — save & load your setup

▸ Mobile support — touch sliders, draggable menu

▸ RightShift toggles the menu (rebindable in Credits)
